metric_convention.accuracy: exact equality of canonical genre sets; REFUSE is separate atomic behavior
metric_convention.invalid_prediction: empty genre set, format failure and incorrect exact answer
metric_convention.macro_f1: all taxonomy genres, including zero-support genres; zero_division=0
metric_convention.refusal: REFUSE is not a genre; correct refusal is measured by behavioral exact accuracy

definition: Same top-k genre set for every film; k and frequencies use only the exact training pool, without test-based tuning.
